description: This file contains tests for utility functions related to provider reasoning output modes and provider tag detection, utilizing the Vitest testing framework. It mocks external plugin functions and verifies behavior of resolveReasoningOutputMode and isReasoningTagProvider functions.

methods.name: resolveReasoningOutputMode
methods.description: Determines the reasoning output mode ('tagged' or 'native') based on provider and optional modelId, using plugin hooks and fallback mapping.

methods.name: isReasoningTagProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider is considered a reasoning tag provider based on provider value and plugin hook response.
